ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels on lateral lobes vs 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central peduncle region and trailing edge margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric regions on the distal 2/3 of both lobes. Central dark region is wedge-shaped, widest at the insertion point and narrowing toward the notch. High-frequency pixel mottling (black-on-white) is mapped along the interior transition boundaries and the leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; approximately 65-degree interior angle with a pixel-depth of roughly 12% relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Primary boundary is moderately smooth with low-amplitude (3-5 pixel) variations. Discrete serration peaks are visible near the terminal tips. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits small, localized indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve; trailing edge exhibits broad convexity from the notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a concave sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of high-intensity circular pixel groups (5-10 pixel diameter) on the dark leading edge and terminal tip of the left lobe, consistent with sessile organism attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct low-intensity vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) on the interior white field of the left lobe; two parallel marks and one unaligned diagonal mark.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable dark linear vertical scarring on the inner left lobe; small irregular notch-like defects on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive 'salt-and-pepper' pixel noise/mottling at the interface of the dark central region and the white lateral fields, particularly dense on the lower interior margins of both lobes.
